title: Stein's method for the Wishart distribution
summary: In this work, we develop Stein's method for the Wishart distribution on the cone of positive definite matrices. We establish the basic ingredients of a Wishart Stein framework: we derive an extended-generator-based Stein characterization from the Wishart diffusion process, identify the corresponding transition semigroup through the noncentral Wishart law, provide an explicit semigroup representation for the solution of the Stein equation, and obtain regularity estimates for the solution.
